senses.gloss: --sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ७३.
--१८ stha1nas, mentioned for enumeration of numbers. Br. IV. 2. १०२: वा. १०१. १०२.
--a deity. Br. IV. १९. ८१. [page१-506+ ३४]
--also गणेश. Br. III. ४१. ४१.

(I)--of भूतस्; followers of शिव, of gods, of Pra- mathas; attacked कृष्ण at शोणितपुर;
1: भा. II. 6. १३: X. [६५ (V) ४६], [४९]: [६६. (V) ४९]: ६३. 6 and १०: XII. १०. १४.
eleven celestial गणस् reckoned.
2: M. 6. ४४-5: ५२. २१.
Twelve groups of seven living with the sun in different parts of the year; their functions.
3: वा. ५२. २४-35.
Three clans of sages with twenty branches each. In the first epoch of सावर्णी; all of them sons of मारीच Kas4yapa, with Bali as their Indra.
4: Ib. १००. १३f.

(II)--five groups of; Yavanas, पारदस्, काम्- bojas, Pahlavas and शकस्; defeated by Sagara, these appealed to वैसिष्ठ who persuaded the king from further slaughter. Sagara changed their dharma and physical features; were degraded क्षत्रियस् and debarred from learn- ing Vedas. Br. III. ६३. १२७.
--is गणेश. Br. III. ४१. ४१.
--courtesans. Br. III. २७. १४ and ४१: ४९. २३.
--the science of computation (Algebra, Geome- try and Arithmetic). वा. ७०. १५.

--is विनायक (s.v.); sprung out of कामेश्वर, thought of by ललीता; destroyed भण्ड's
1: भा. III. ४१. ३७-41: ४२. 2 and ३३: ४३. १८ and ३१: ४४. ७०. Br. IV. २७. ७२-104: ४४. ६७.
followers and filled the शक्ति host with enthusiasm. Killed गजासुर (s.v.). His riding animal was rat. ललिता honoured him as the first [page१-507+ ३५] to be worshipped among gods;
1: भा. III. ४१. ३७-41: ४२. 2 and ३३: ४३. १८ and ३१: ४४. ७०. Br. IV. २७. ७२-104: ४४. ६७.
was Nikumbha in whose honour दिवोदास built a temple.
2: Br. III. ६७. ५५.
The head of a शिव gan2a who sports in sidda-क्षेत्रस्, Rathyas, desolate gardens and places where there are children, the mad and others. Icons of;
3: M. २३. ३८ and ८४: १५४. ५२४, ५३३-41: २५०. २५, २५९. २३.
origin in an ele- phant-faced doll made by पार्वती from the oil and dirt scraped off her body in the course of an oil bath; cast into Ganges where he grew in size and became गान्गेय.
4: M. १५४. ५०२-5.

--formerly men who by ब्रह्मचर्य and pil- grimages pleased शन्कर and attained this status; very dear to शिव; पार्वती's first view of them; their habits and food; वीरक, (s.v.) one of them attracted पार्वती's atten- tion. M. १५४. ५२२. to ४१.
--a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८२.
--apparently a town; to the East of माल्यवत्; on the slopes of the गन्धमाधन and the माल्यवत; in the first line केतुमालस्; and there is a महावृक्ष Janasa. M. ११३. ५१: वा. ४३. 1-4. [page१-508+ ३७]
--a son of शूर and a brother of Vasudeva; Issueless adopted चारूदेष्ण and साम्भ, sons of कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. १५० and १९१: वा. ९६. १४८, १८८. Vi. IV. १४. ३०.
--sacred to गणपति. Br. IV. ३८. 5.

--the abode of गणपति;
1: Br. II. २७. १२३: IV. 7. ५९.
attained by the सूद्र who is not addicted to drink.
2: वा. १०१. ३५४.
[page१-526+ ३८]

--the arrow of Arjuna;
1: भा. I. 7. १६: 9. १५; X. ५८. १३.
the bow of Arjuna lost its power after कृष्ण's departure to heaven.
2: Vi. V. ३८. २१, २३ and ४५.
